page.name: june's super cool super easy webring template ꔛ

content.p: do you want to make a webring? not know anything about javascript? well boy howdy are you in luck.
introducing: webstring.js! a super-simple alternative to garlic.garden's excellent onionring.

ul.li: it's a single file, for ease of editing & use.
it's compact—not counting the settings object, the raw code's only 8 lines long.
there's customization options! want to use a stylesheet? add multiple widgets? scroll down and ask the wizard.

content.h2: how do i start a webring?

i highly recommend giving your widget html an id="" with the name of your webring, otherwise it's really difficult for webring members to add custom styling to their widgets.
